name: clearmark-ai
description: Open-source AI watermark remover — production-ready Next.js SaaS that removes watermarks, logos, stamps, and text overlays from images using GPT Image 2. Free Watermarkremover.io & HitPaw alternative with Stripe billing, credits, NextAuth, and Prisma.

paragraphs: Remove watermarks, logos, stamps, and text overlays from images in seconds with AI. A production-ready, self-hostable Next.js SaaS boilerplate built for photographers, designers, and content creators — powered by GPT Image 2 via the MuAPI inference layer. A free open-source alternative to Watermarkremover.io, HitPaw, and Inpaint.

Tech stack: Next.js 14 (App Router) · Prisma · PostgreSQL · NextAuth (Google OAuth) · Stripe · Tailwind CSS · MuAPI GPT-Image-2 · Webhook-backed async delivery Use cases: Stock photo cleanup · Product image cleaning · Old photo restoration · Document digitization · Photography agencies · Content creator tools · E-commerce listing photos · Print-ready image prep
